scope: Distinct interaction formats after user feedback

assets.title: Live workspace
assets.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a bold high-fidelity interface exploration for "Tangent Space", a web community app for people and independently operated agents. This is a speculative PRODUCT SCREENSHOT BOARD showing a genuinely different interaction format, not a marketing site, dashboard template or moodboard. Use a wide landscape board with a short concept title at the very top; a LARGE dominant desktop screenshot filling the upper two thirds; and THREE smaller supporting screenshots in a strip along the bottom labeled "First visit", "Home", "Mobile". Flat straight-on screenshots, sharp readable text, no physical device frames, no perspectives. The dominant screenshot must show an active conversation with usable controls and populated text. Use the composition to make the format instantly distinguishable.
Product hierarchy: Tangent = community; Topic = conversation; Post = contribution. Never label places rooms or channels. Public content is readable without signup. Agent authors receive one quiet "Agent" label, not robots or special power controls. No mandatory new feature setup steps for visitors.
Shared illustrative content: community "Night Garden" with purpose "Small observations, bigger questions." Its recognizable photograph is a botanical conservatory at dusk, warmly lit glass amid lush foliage. Other communities "The Workshop" use a workbench photo and "Far Horizons" use a misty coast photo. Each community has one identifying image; do not assign unrelated decorative photographs to every conversation.
Main Topic title "What makes a city feel alive?" Opening by Mara: "What's one place that makes your city feel alive?" Ivo replies: "The corner bakery. Nobody hurries you." Lumen, Agent, replies: "A bench can matter as much as a landmark." Mara replies to Lumen: "A place to linger without having to buy anything." Nia replies to Mara's opening: "The last bus home. It makes the city feel open to everyone." These are attributed contributions, not AI summaries. Author portraits or initial avatars consistent throughout. Example signed-in person Mara.
Show "Public · Anyone can read" in the active Topic and "Replying as Mara" on the composer. Audience is a STATIC label, never a dropdown beside a reply. Sign-in required to contribute can appear only in the anonymous First visit screen. Use a meaningful reply target. Clear search, return path and understated contextual settings are discoverable but not visually dominant.
The prior proposals overused community-card galleries followed by Topic lists followed by spacious linear threads. Do NOT merely restyle that formula. No generic landing hero, no three big image cards as the whole homepage, no unread debt badge, no online counts, no gamified points/streaks, no lorem ipsum. Beautiful typography is welcome but the arrangement and behavior must be the innovation. Legible, credible, detailed enough for product critique.

CONCEPT TITLE: "01 / Live workspace".
Primary mental model: a Discord-like community workspace, with Zulip-like durable named conversations. Dark graphite/slate, bright electric periwinkle selection, restrained warm conservatory imagery. Modern compact sans-serif type. Visibly DENSE and EDGE-TO-EDGE, comfortable for lively short exchanges; this must look like a place people can inhabit together rather than a website with centered cards.
MAIN SCREEN: four functional vertical zones. Far left a narrow 64px rail of three cropped photographic Tangent tiles, Night Garden visibly selected, plus Explore at bottom; not generic circles, use image crops as recognizable visual bookmarks. Next a 210px dark community navigator: small conservatory banner, "Night Garden", its purpose, section "Conversations", city topic selected, "An ordinary thing worth noticing", "A small ritual for the week", "Night walks", and a clear "+ Start a conversation". Main center roughly 55% is a compact chronological message flow with Topic header and public audience, grouped author messages, quiet timestamps, parent-reply snippets, the supplied Mara/Ivo/Lumen/Nia exchange, then one recent Mara reply. No card box per post, no speech bubbles, no giant serif headline. Sticky composer at bottom "Replying as Mara", text input "Add to the conversation..." and Send reply. A quiet date divider separates Yesterday and Today. Reading older messages is not force-scrolled.
At right a 300px optional sidepane titled "Replies to Lumen", showing the original Lumen bench contribution and Mara's directly connected response, with a scoped composer "Reply to Lumen". Show the selected Lumen post softly highlighted in the center so it is clear this pane is a local view of the SAME Topic, not another chat space. Header includes "Back to conversation" / close icon. No giant member sidebar, no voice channels, no fake microphone UI. "New replies · Show" sits subtly above center composer, not an urgent red badge.
SUPPORTING FIRST VISIT: same workspace skeleton, community identity visible, a modest inline welcome "Read a conversation. Join when you're ready.", readable city conversation underneath and Sign in to reply. No full-screen form blocking the content.
SUPPORTING HOME: selected Night Garden workspace with navigator and a compact center list of active named conversations and excerpts; community rail persists. No gallery cards and no website hero.
SUPPORTING MOBILE: one active chronological Topic fills narrow width with compact Night Garden image signature, back navigation to Conversations, same author flow and bottom composer. One small "Replies to Lumen" link opens a full-width reply-context screen instead of squeezing side panes.

CONCEPT TITLE: "02 / Branching forum".
Primary mental model: an open conversation tree where every response visibly belongs to a particular thought. A radically different silhouette from chat or a three-column dashboard. Warm ivory background, dark ink text, vivid copper and teal branch highlights, crisp readable sans with strong typographic hierarchy. Precise hairline connector paths, collapsible branches and a focused ancestral path. NO compulsory support/oppose voting, no debate claim/rebuttal labels.
MAIN SCREEN: top app header with Tangent Space and search. Below it a SHORT row of photographic community tabs, Night Garden selected with its conservatory thumbnail. Main content a wide branching conversation: at top one root opening Post by Mara with large city question and public audience. From its lower edge a vertical trunk with clearly visible connector lines splits into THREE distinct reply branches arranged across the available width: left Ivo's bakery contribution, middle Lumen Agent's bench contribution, right Nia's bus contribution. These must be readable real posts connected by lines, not a marketing diagram of empty boxes. Under Lumen's post, a further connector leads to Mara's "A place to linger..." response. That branch is selected, softly tinted; an INLINE composer directly beneath says "Replying to Lumen as Mara", static Public reply, a short draft and Post reply. Each branch has a compact collapse/expand affordance with a plain label such as "Hide replies". Small "All replies in time order" control at top right offers a chronological alternative. Upper-left compact breadcrumb shows Night Garden / City conversation. A minimal branch-path indicator helps preserve ancestry. Most of screen is reply-tree, no dominant conventional conversation sidebar.
SUPPORTING FIRST VISIT: root question and its three branches immediately visible, small inline hint "Pick a reply to follow that line of thought" and Read discussion. Anonymous audience and sign-in-to-reply clear.
SUPPORTING HOME: selected Tangent's photo as compact banner; titled Topics are represented by dense horizontal rows with miniature reply-branch silhouettes showing structure, author and excerpt. City conversation first. No giant image gallery, no hero copy.
SUPPORTING MOBILE: only one selected reply path shown full width, root excerpt → Lumen contribution → Mara reply, with a compact "Other replies" control, ancestor breadcrumb and a full-width inline composer. Do not infinitely indent into an unreadable narrow column.
Strong visual distinction: the main board must show a true root-and-branches spatial reading structure with obvious reply relationships. Keep each card simple, like a Post, not a community cover.

CONCEPT TITLE: "03 / Conversation atlas — exploratory".
Primary mental model: exploring a map of connected conversations. This is the deliberately WILD option, a usable community canvas with a docked reading panel. Night charcoal background, warm conservatory image identity, muted colorful topic nodes, exact legible type and thin curved connection lines. Think thoughtful map application for conversation, not a sci-fi network visualization. No random glowing dots or 3D planets.
MAIN SCREEN: top app bar Tangent Space, search, visible "Map" selected / "List" alternate toggle. Small image bookmark strip switches Tangents. The selected Night Garden conservatory photograph appears in a compact top-left identity panel with purpose; it is NOT a full-screen wallpaper impairing text. Main LEFT 60% is a genuine freeform spatial canvas with stable positioned labeled Topic nodes of varied modest sizes and visible whitespace between clusters. Central selected node titled "What makes a city feel alive?" with Mara and short excerpt. Curved directional connectors, explicitly labeled "Continued from", connect this node to separate Topics "Who gets to linger?" and "The last bus home". Another neighborhood has "An ordinary thing worth noticing" and "A small ritual for the week". Two unrelated nodes have no fake connection. Actual titles occupy meaningful rectangles, no anonymous dots. Selected node and its incoming/outgoing connections highlighted amber. Map zoom +/−, recenter and a tiny map key in bottom left are subtle. A small "Start a conversation" action belongs to Night Garden.
RIGHT 40% is a docked tall reader for the selected CITY Topic. Compact image signature and title, public audience, Mara opening and the Ivo/Lumen Agent/Nia replies, inline public composer Replying as Mara. It is real readable thread content, not a statistical inspector. The map remains visible to orient the reader. A "Take this on a tangent" text action on Lumen's post suggests an explicitly linked continuation, not automated semantic classification.
SUPPORTING FIRST VISIT: Night Garden cover with one labeled starting node and simple choice "Explore conversations" or "Browse as a list"; no skills tutorial or forced pan gesture.
SUPPORTING HOME: the Night Garden Topic map at overview zoom, labeled neighborhoods, one visible trail from the city conversation toward related Topics; community image bookmark strip persists.
SUPPORTING MOBILE: primary view is a full-width reader; below it a clean text list "Connected conversations" with explicit relationship labels. Tiny optional Show map control. Do NOT squeeze the whole map and dock side by side on phone.
Make this look unmistakably like an explorable community ATLAS with a true map and reader. Illustrative links are intentional authored relationships, not AI guesses. New content never rearranges the whole map. No finance graphs, knowledge-graph jargon, popularity bubbles, radar charts or image-card galleries.

CONCEPT TITLE: "04 / Correspondence".
Primary mental model: a finite visit through a few conversations, one at a time. Deliberately different from chat and dashboards. A focused full-screen reading session with a visible beginning, optional next conversation and a gracious ending; NOT another magazine homepage. Extremely restrained app chrome, warm near-white reading sheet against a deep desaturated forest surround, large beautiful sans/serif mixture for readable prose. The Tangent photograph is a narrow vertical bookmark/edge strip identifying the current community, not a gallery cover.
MAIN SCREEN: edge-to-edge focused session with small top header Tangent Space, "Your reading", "Browse all". Near top center "Conversation 2 of 3" with three small neutral sequence markers, not a progress score. One large CENTERED reading page occupies almost all usable width, without a persistent navigation sidebar. Night Garden image bookmark attached to its left edge and its name/purpose inside. City Topic title, Public anyone-can-read label, author Mara and opening question; an elegant readable sequence of Ivo's response, Lumen Agent's bench response and Mara's directly connected answer. Replies are plainly attributed, indented only for local connection. A quiet inline "Read all replies" action preserves access to complete conversation and does not imply an AI summary. Compose area directly follows, Replying as Mara and static Public reply. No data dashboard or omnipresent controls.
A prominent calm bottom navigation band OUTSIDE the reading page shows a previous conversation title at left, current Night Garden image signature in middle, "Next: A small ritual for the week →" at right. A clearly visible "Finish for now" text action means the person can end without completing anything. No "you're behind", streaks, quotas, forced order, countdown, infinite scroll or success score. This should feel like opening correspondence and responding, not consuming a feed.
SUPPORTING FIRST VISIT: a focused invitation anchored by the Night Garden image strip and ONE actual question preview, "Read this conversation" plus "Browse all"; a person can start reading without personalizing or creating an account.
SUPPORTING HOME: a finite contents page headed "A few conversations to revisit", three elegant numbered entries with narrow photographic source strips, real Topic titles and recent author excerpts. "Choose where to begin" and "Browse all Tangents" make selection voluntary. No big community-card grid and no unread-count dashboard.
SUPPORTING MOBILE: full-width reading session, Night Garden image bookmark, Conversation 2 of 3, city question and attributed replies, accessible reply composer, explicit Previous / Next controls and Finish for now. This is not a swipe-only carousel. At bottom show a small end-state preview "A good place to pause" with Browse more, not reward confetti.
The screenshot must convey the FINITE SESSION structure clearly: one primary conversation, numbered contents when choosing, sequence when reading, explicit pause/ending. Preserve source context and individual voices; no unsupported generated summaries.
